thread:
nina.sales: Quick sync 10xHealth wants SOC2 excerpts + signed pen-test attestation for a 2-week POC. They also asked if we can issue ephemeral KMS keys and a presigned upload for their auditors. Any technical/security blockers?
sam.se: We can issue ephemeral creds and presigned uploads. Need to confirm egress and single-use upload flow.
jordan.sec: Security notes: (1) pen-test attestation template needs buyer signer details; (2) ephemeral KMS on Private requires KMS owner approval and a 1-page runbook; (3) SOC2 will be redacted for internal IPs/service accounts.
nina.sales: They want everything by Friday EOD. Can we get the draft attestation + SOC2 redacted bundle by then?
pat.pm: I'll assemble a minimal evidence bundle. Jordan, confirm redaction pattern.
jordan.sec: Use standard redaction: remove internal IP ranges and identifiable hostnames. I'll add the checklist. evidence-bot: SOC2 redacted snapshot uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/soc2/10x-2026-04-10.zip
sam.se: For ephemeral KMS we need (a) staging CIDR(s) for allowlist, (b) rotation window preference. Note: Dedicated KMS isolation impacts pricing.
nina.sales: CIDRs provided in email. I'll confirm rotation window and signer. Add Dedicated delta to quote please.
sam.se: Estimated delta for Dedicated + KMS isolation: +$3,400/mo (estimate).
jordan.sec: If they require independent 3rd-party red-team evidence instead of our attestation, timeline adds ~2 weeks.
pat.pm: Evidence checklist: 1) SOC2 redacted report 2) network diagram 3) pen-test draft 4) KMS keyflow diagram 5) presigned upload snippet 6) ephemeral creds runbook
nina.sales: presigned snippet to show their devs?
sam.se: Example: ```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/10x-poc.zip --expires-in 3600
```
jordan.sec: Security note: use <=1h expiry, single-use tracking, and log request_id.
nina.sales: Can the attestation state we support on-prem HSMs?
jordan.sec: Allowed wording: "Redwood supports Private deployments with customer-managed KMS/HSM integrations." Do not list specific vendors.
pat.pm: I'll upload the bundle and ping Legal for quick sign-off on the attestation. evidence-bot: Pen-test-attestation-template_v1.docx uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/templates/pen-test-attestation_v1.docx
nina.sales: Thanks all 1 will update the prospect and request signer details. If anything blocks I'll re-open the thread.
